# J5 COA validation and comparison, JTF BEACON

> UNCLASSIFIED // EXERCISE // FICTIONAL DATA

Method from AJP-5.

## Criteria

Mission accomplishment, speed to the harbour, risk to the force, risk to civilians, sustainability.

## Comparison matrix

| Criterion | Weight | COA A | COA B |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mission accomplishment | 3 | 3 | 2 |
| Speed to the harbour | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Risk to the force | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Risk to civilians | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Sustainability | 1 | 3 | 2 |
| Total | | 22 | 19 |

## Recommendation with risk

COA A. Main risk: the MDCOA counterattack at Ashby Ford, mitigated by a decision point to commit the reserve. COA B depends on A-4 and on a strait clear of mines, which nobody has checked.

## Dissent

Red team, unedited: COA B keeps more options if the strait is clear. Confidence that it is clear is low.

## Decisions for the commander

DECISION FOR: commander. Choose COA A, COA B, or ask for more work.
